## Ajay Joshi

Permanent Address: Vill- phali , P.O. - senti Vikash nagar ghat ,Chamoli Pin code - 246435 State -  uttarakhand

Mobile:+919634057802

Email:

joshiajay688 @gmail.com

## OBJECTIVE

To be associated with a company that provides career development opportunities. That shall yield the twin benefits of job satisfaction and a steady paced. Professional growth and where I can apply & enhance my knowledge, skill to serve. The firm to the best of my efforts.

## EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

- Secondary from JIC naya gaon , Dehradun in 2014
- Sr. Secondary (Science) from JIC naya gaon , Dehradun in 2016
- Graduation (B.Sc) from HNBGU, Shrinagar  in 2019

## WORK EXPERIENCE

- Presently working as Security Officer in Bhilosa Industries Pvt Ltd from 18 October 202 1 to till date.

## JOB PROFILE:

- Pro-actively ensuring the protection of property and assets.
- Creating a safe and comfortable working environment for employees and visitors.
- Patrolling inside the company premises.
- Responding to emergency situations as they arise.
- Accurately reporting all incidents to seniors As well as the management.
- Audits of security documents on regular basis.
- Attend  mock drills on constantly.
- Preventing and detecting offense on site.
- Conducting searches of personnel, vehicles and belongings etc.
- Monitoring  CCTV  cameras.
- Checking and validating business visitor credentials and visitor management.
- Total Vehicle management inside the company area as well as parking plazas.
- Making sure that no unauthorized personnel enter restricted areas.
- Collecting statements and evidence in reported allegations.
- Escalating incidents when required to.
- Handling different kind of incident / accidents including road accident, fire incident, operational incident and undertaking investigations of such accidents/incidents.
- Maintaining the attendance records.
- Briefing to drivers regarding road safety awareness and checking of all vehicles for road fitness
- Directing emergency vehicles QRT and other traffic during emergencies .

<!-- image -->

## COMPETENCIES:

- Hard working and possess good observation skills.
- Aware of health and safety issues.
- Dealing with people politely but in an authoritative manner.
- Computer literate, in MS Office, Excel, VMS,  & SAP software.
- Capability to monitor information feeds simultaneously from multiple sources.
- Having a professional approach to all routine tasks and ability to work collaboratively
- Experience of monitoring and controlling security equipment.
- Excellent time-management skills.
- Ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
- Experience of working on major events.
- Cool minded with a positive attitude
- Imparting physical on- job training to newly joined security personnel

## PERSONAL

- Punctual, well-groomed and confident.
- Having a professional attitude.
- Possessing a friendly, approachable personality.
- Willing to work on all shifts

## PHYSICAL EFFICIENTY

- Height: 169 cms.

- Weight: 61 kgs.

## EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

- NCC 'C' Certificate with B grade

## HOBBIES

- Playing games.
- Cooking food.
- Traveling and listening to music

Unmarried
